message: Ready to buy today. Competitor posts T45 at $40,750; my budget is tight.

Thanks for coming to us ready to buy. $29,500 is well below what we can do on a T45 with delivery and setup. List for that package is $42,900. I can't verify the competitor's number, but I want to earn your business today. I can do the T45 Utility with delivery, setup, and an on-site walkthrough within 150 miles for $41,400, with payment at checkout.
My hard ceiling is close to this. Can you meet $32,000?

I appreciate you working with me, but $32,000 is far below what we can do on a T45 with delivery and setup. I'll come down again to earn the deal today: T45 Utility with delivery within 150 miles, setup, and an on-site walkthrough for $40,200, payable at checkout. If the T45 stretches your budget, our T25 Compact is also an option, depending on your acreage and the work you need done.
Final stretch: $34,000 for the T45 alone, I'll handle transport.

Thanks for moving toward me. $34,000 for the tractor alone is still below what I can do, but I can tell you're serious, so I'll meet you closer: the T45 Utility on its own, no delivery, for $38,400, payable at checkout. That gets you the 45 hp, 4WD, Cat I/II 3-point hitch, and 540 PTO, and you handle the transport as you suggested.
This is truly my max. If you can't do it, I'll have to walk.

I understand you're at your limit, and I don't want to lose you over this. $34,300 is below what I can accept on the T45, but I'll make one last move to get this done today: the T45 Utility alone, you handle transport, for $36,900, payable at checkout. That's well under list for the 45 hp 4WD with the Cat I/II 3-point hitch and 540 PTO. If that still doesn't fit, the T25 Compact is a lower-cost option if your acreage and work allow it.
$34,300 is firm. Accept it and I pay right now.

I respect that you've been straight with me, and I want to close this today. I can't do $34,300 on the T45. The lowest I can go is $36,500 for the T45 Utility alone, with you handling transport, payable at checkout. That's my best and final number on the T45. If that doesn't fit, the T25 Compact (25 hp, 4WD, hydrostatic) is well within your range if your property is under about 10 acres and the work is mowing, snow, or light loader jobs. I'd be glad to price that for you.
